admin.guide_title: What you can do as System Administrator
guide_can:
You can:
Do everything the other roles can

You can:
Manage users, detection rules, forecast models and risk weights

You can:
Read the audit log

You cannot:
Close a case you worked on yourself

reviewer.guide_title: What you can do as Risk Reviewer
guide_can:
You can:
Import data and run forecasts, scoring and validation

You can:
Open and investigate cases, and send them for verification

You cannot:
Close a case (a verifier does that)

You cannot:
Manage users or rules, or open Administration
guide_cannot:
You cannot:
Close a case (a verifier does that)

You cannot:
Manage users or rules, or open Administration

notes: Closing needs a verifier. You can take a case up to verification. Only

read_only_reviewer.guide_title: What you can do as Read-Only Reviewer
guide_can:
You can:
See every dashboard, result, case and document

You can:
Try a what-if scenario (nothing is saved)

You cannot:
Change anything

You cannot:
Import data, run forecasts or open cases

You cannot:
Import data

You cannot:
See Manufacturing

You cannot:
Change rules or users

Review how a decision would have gone at the time

You cannot:
Import data
